hero.lede: Find your place here. Homes sit on land the community holds together, and a Land Share Agreement is how you take one.

items.title: Mountain Views
items.body: Many lots offer stunning views of the surrounding mountains and valleys.

items.title: Water Access
items.body: Natural springs and streams throughout the property provide clean water.

items.title: Mature Forest
items.body: Existing forest provides shade, privacy, and connection to nature.

items.title: Solar Exposure
items.body: Lots are positioned for optimal solar energy and natural lighting.

tenure.heading: Land Share Agreements
tenure.intro: At {village}, you don't purchase land outright: you acquire a Land Share Agreement that gives you long-term access to your lot. This unique structure:

points.title: Renewable
points.body: Your agreement can be renewed, providing long-term security for your family.

points.title: Transferable
points.body: Pass your land share to your children, keeping it in the family. Ask a steward about this village's specific transfer and tax terms.

points.title: Community Owned
points.body: The land remains in community ownership, ensuring our values are preserved.

cta.body: Join a community call to learn about available lots, pricing, and the process for becoming a resident.
